lines.text: How do you survive... the Undertow?
You're the night keeper of a lonely lighthouse, and at midnight, the great lamp goes dark.
Then, something crawls out of the sea.
It walks on its hands and feet, bent backwards... and its head hangs upside down.
When it stands up, it's ten feet tall.
Rule number one: it can't touch the light. But in the dark, it's faster than you.
And now, it has seen you.
Run for your boat? No. The water is where it hunts.
Hide in the rocks? It smells you, and it's on you in seconds.
Here's what works. Get inside, run to the top, and relight the lamp.
It climbs the tower... and presses its face against the glass.
At sunrise, it lets go, and slides back into the sea.
Would you have survived? Follow, because part seven is coming for you.
